description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions related to the 'Stats' component of the Excalidraw project, including element movement, group handling, and property management.

methods.name: isPropertyEditable
methods.description: Checks if a property of an element is editable, disallowing 'angle' for frame-like elements.

methods.name: getStepSizedValue
methods.description: Calculates a step-sized value based on a given step size.

methods.name: getElementsInAtomicUnit
methods.description: Retrieves elements within an atomic unit, considering original and current element maps.

methods.name: newOrigin
methods.description: Calculates a new origin point for an element to keep its top-left corner fixed after resizing.

methods.name: moveElement
methods.description: Moves an element to a new position, updating bindings and handling group elements accordingly.

methods.name: getAtomicUnits
methods.description: Generates atomic units from selected elements and groups based on current app state.
